experiments.name: Copying FOMO app traders
experiments.question: Can we front-run or copy the best FOMO app wallets?
experiments.method: On-chain audit of 60+ wallets, 7-day forward test
experiments.result: Winners churn; copying after the fact loses to fees and slippage.

experiments.name: Technical signals on liquid memecoins
experiments.question: Does any TA entry beat random in 27 liquid memecoins?
experiments.result: Every strategy lost 2–5% per trade; none beat random.

experiments.name: Tweet sniper on fresh launches
experiments.question: Do influencer tweets predict pumps early enough to buy?
experiments.method: Dataset of tweets vs. 6h outcomes, shadow run
experiments.result: Signals arrive after the move; snipers own the first minutes.

experiments.name: Anti-rug: common-funder clustering
experiments.question: Can we detect rugs by tracing who funded the top holders?
experiments.method: Helius funded-by on top-20 holders + deployer history, applied live
experiments.result: Caught 3 concentrated tokens before buying (CHICO, tSpaceX, LMAO!).

experiments.name: Perps signals on Hyperliquid
experiments.question: Any short-term long/short edge in perps (funding, cascades, breakouts, pairs)?
experiments.method: 34 markets, 90 days, real funding, out-of-sample, random control
experiments.result: None passed (t ≥ 2.5 and beat random). Volume breakouts lose clearly (−1.5%/trade).

experiments.name: Fast momentum in $300K–3M memecoins
experiments.question: Does buying small caps already up 100%+ 'on a pullback' work with 12h time stops?
experiments.result: Both stopped out within an hour (−26%, −28%). Turned off the same night.

experiments.name: Stops that only move up
experiments.question: Does ratcheting the stop with the peak keep more of the winners?
experiments.method: Live on GTA6/REMUS; rules 1.3x→entry, 1.6x→75% of peak
experiments.result: REMUS closed +14% instead of round-tripping; GTA6 protected at 1.3x.

experiments.name: Volatility targeting + drawdown throttle
experiments.question: Does sizing each pocket to a fixed volatility (and cutting exposure after a drawdown) improve risk-adjusted results?
experiments.method: Replay pocket signals fixed-size vs vol-targeted (10/20-day half-life); same costs; random-entry control
experiments.result: Queued. Evidence: arXiv 2602.11708 (OOS 2022–25: Sharpe 0.65→1.83, maxDD 35%→16%); arXiv 2603.23480

experiments.name: Execution cost audit + MEV protection
experiments.question: How much of our 2–5% round trip is fee vs impact vs sandwiches, and how much can tight slippage / Jito-protected sends recover?
experiments.method: Decompose our own fills with Helius; then live A/B on alternating tickets (protected vs not)
experiments.result: Queued. Evidence: Helius Solana MEV report: one program ~51.6K sandwiches/day, 16 of top-20 sandwiched tokens are Pump.fun

experiments.name: Wash-trading / price-inflation filter
experiments.question: Do the USENIX'26 manipulation flags cut drawdowns in picks without killing winners?
experiments.method: Tag past candidates at entry; compare 7/30-day returns and >50% drawdown rate, flagged vs clean vs random same-bucket
experiments.result: Queued. Evidence: arXiv 2507.01963: 82.6% of +100% memecoins showed artificial growth; 86.7% of dumped tokens had prior manipulation

experiments.name: Token-unlock avoidance / short
experiments.question: Do large team/investor unlocks (>1% supply) depress price from ~30 days before?
experiments.method: Short day −30→−1 vs SOL/ETH hedge, vol-sized; control = same token, random 30-day windows
experiments.result: Queued. Evidence: Keyrock (16K unlocks, ~90% negative, team unlocks ≈ −25%); Tokenomist (236 events)

experiments.name: Short new perp listings after day 1
experiments.question: Do newly listed perps drift down over 7–14 days?
experiments.method: Short at day-1 close, exit d7/d14, 2x stop; pool Hyperliquid + Binance listings; control = random similar-cap perps same dates
experiments.result: Queued. Evidence: The Tie 2026 (1,844 listings, mean-revert in 1–2 weeks); Four Pillars (Upbit/Bithumb 2025 day-1 buyers kept ~$0.31/$1)

experiments.name: Multi-lookback trend ensemble + ATR trailing stop
experiments.question: Is a 10/20/55/100-day breakout ensemble with ATR trail sturdier than the single 20-day MA?
experiments.method: Walk-forward on years of Binance daily candles; same costs/sizing; random long/short control with matched holding time
experiments.result: Queued. Evidence: Zarattini–Pagani–Barbon SSRN 5209907 (Sharpe >1.5 net, 2015+); AdaptiveTrend ablation (trail: maxDD 22%→13%)

experiments.name: Smart-money breadth (not copy trading)
experiments.question: Does the change in how many historically profitable wallets hold a token predict returns?
experiments.method: Select wallets on months 1–3, test weekly rank on months 4–6; control = matched random portfolios
experiments.result: Queued. Evidence: Nansen (ETH 2020–22, self-published, no costs) — weak

experiments.name: CEX listing-announcement trade
experiments.question: Buying a Solana token on-chain at a Coinbase/Upbit/Robinhood announcement and selling at listing — still alive after 2023?
experiments.method: 2024–26 announcements; entry at +1/5/15 min, exit at listing; control = random times same tokens prior week
experiments.result: Queued. Evidence: The Tie (Coinbase n=10, +24% median day-1; shrinking since 2023); BONK/PENGU anecdotes

protocol: Out-of-sample half held out, entries at next bar open, real costs (memes ~3% round trip, perps 0.12% + funding), random-entry control x20; adopt only if test mean > 0, t ≥ 2.5, beats random by ≥ 0.3%/trade, design half also positive. Risk/cost changes are judged on drawdown and realized cost, not on win rate.
